tokenization: NFC + casefold + Unicode alphanumeric syllables/numbers; keep accents; no stopwords; unique query terms
filter_policy: Apply the same explicit user doc_type/year filter to all retrievers; fixed global BM25 statistics

hypotheses.dense: Semantic matching baseline using the inherited real vector index.
hypotheses.bm25: Exact legal terms, article numbers and deadlines may benefit from lexical retrieval.
